verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll markets a built-in 'Payroll AI' that takes on specific tasks: it collects time and attendance data, flags inconsistencies, and texts the admin updates. That is real but narrow delegation, backed by a single marketing claim. Auto-payroll and expert-run payroll are rule-based automation and a human service, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose assistant users can hand arbitrary tasks to (for example via chat or natural-language commands), documentation of the AI's scope and controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Your Payroll AI proactively collects time and attendance data from your employees, spots inconsistencies, and texts your admin updates
